name: Staging to production content promotion
description: Promote reviewed content changes: verify the production snapshot, apply the agreed edits, sweep dev URLs out, and keep the journal as the rollback path.

steps.title: Pre-flight
steps.detail: Call wp_site_snapshot and wp_get_site_info: confirm this is the PRODUCTION site (ask twice if unsure) and record the current state.

steps.title: Apply the content set
steps.detail: For the agreed list, call wp_update_post (or wp_create_post for new pages) with the reviewed copy from staging; verify each with wp_get_post.

steps.title: URL sweep
steps.detail: Call wp_search_replace (dry-run semantics first: count matches before replacing) to rewrite staging hostnames in the promoted content; run the replacement only on the agreed ids.

steps.title: Verify
steps.detail: Call wp_get_recent_activity and wp_list_changes to show exactly what moved; anything unexpected is immediately discussed (wp_undo_change is the escape hatch).

steps.title: Report
steps.detail: Deliver the promoted-items list with ids, the URL sweep result, and the rollback instructions.

guardrails: wp_search_replace runs only on the agreed post ids and never on user tables.
Stop immediately if the site does not look like production (maintenance mode, placeholder content).
